title: Feature to assign an icon to the CompactRepresentation
line: Quicklaunch has a new "Popup icon" setting, so its popup button in a panel can show any icon instead of the arrow.
explanation: When Quicklaunch's popup is enabled, its button in a panel always showed a direction arrow with the generic "Show hidden icons" tooltip, so several Quicklaunch widgets on one panel looked identical and gave no hint of what each popup contained. The change adds a popupIcon setting (empty by default, which keeps the arrow and its rotation) and a "Popup icon:" button in the General page, using the same Choose…/Reset to default icon menu as the Web Browser and Application Launcher widgets. The button is enabled only when "Enable popup" is checked.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: allow choosing an icon for the popup button

In a panel the popup button always showed an arrow, so with several
Quicklaunch widgets there was no way to tell their popups apart. Add a
"Popup icon" setting, defaulting to the arrow, like other widgets have.

BUG: 498274
